newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China smashes illegal salt production operation.
newsitem.headline: China smashes illegal salt production operation.

text.p: Chinese officials have smashed an illegal salt manufacturing and trading operation in the southern Guangdong city of Dongguan and seized 450 tonnes of salt, the Shenzhen Special Zone Daily said on Tuesday.

The newspaper said those involved had built a make-shift salt processing factory, made fake logos and bags and stored most of their salt in a warehouse less than 200 metres away from the Guangdong Provincial Salt Industry Corp office.
It said the illegal salt would harm the city's salt market and affect the population's health, but gave no details.
